untie_word_embeddings: untie word embeddings of a transformers model by cloning weights and disabling tie_word_embeddings config
test_targets_embeddings: test whether given named modules target the input or output word embeddings of a transformers model
get_embeddings: get the input and output embedding modules from a transformers PreTrainedModel
refactor_untie_word_embeddings: refactor untie_word_embeddings to support models with custom embedding retrieval
review_get_embeddings: review get_embeddings to handle additional embedding retrieval exceptions
